data.name: Reasons.Intro
data.value: Why stock is corrected. Every stock adjustment names one of these reasons; archived reasons stay on past adjustments but cannot be chosen.

data.name: Reasons.CodeHelp
data.value: Capital letters, digits or underscores, e.g. DAMAGED. Fixed after creation.

data.name: Roles.Intro
data.value: A role is a named bundle of permissions; a position's role template gives its employees the permissions of its roles. Seeded roles can be renamed and their permissions changed; "Reset to default" restores the permissions they shipped with. The locked Administrator and Superadministrator roles cannot be changed, but "Copy" makes an editable role from any role. Brand and hub scope come from assignments.

data.name: Roles.CodeHelp
data.value: 3 to 30 capital letters or underscores, e.g. PURCHASING_CLERK.

data.name: Csv.Rules
data.value: UTF-8, comma or semicolon separated, at most 10 MB and 50,000 rows. Rows are matched by code: new codes are created, existing ones updated, unchanged rows skipped. You see a preview first; nothing is written until you apply it.

data.value: More than 5 % of the rows have errors, so the file cannot be applied. Correct the rows and choose the file again.

data.value: Makers of parts, for example MANN+HUMMEL for a filter sold under a machinery brand. A part may name one; the parts import fills it from the optional manufacturer_code column. A manufacturer with active parts cannot be archived.
